caption:
Foreign investors had been cautious on Indian stocks for months. In November, that changed - fast.

Foreign Portfolio Investors poured Rs 99,158 crore into Indian equities this month (through Nov 18 alone) - the highest monthly FPI inflow into Indian equities on record, surpassing the previous record of $8.4 billion set in December 2020.

NSDL data shows over a trillion rupees in net inflows between late October and mid-November alone, with financials and auto stocks drawing the most money.

Foreign money doesn't move on sentiment alone. This is a bet that India's growth story is still worth buying into.

Sources: Business Standard, Paterson Capital (November 2026)
